This is DeepSeek Harness describing their Super-agent architecture: one continuous always-on agent that stays online across IM, GitHub etc. A long-lived Router handles all human interaction and dispatches work; isolated Workers run tasks in parallel with full tools. Event-driven, proactive, recovers automatically. Research prototype, not a product.

No connection to Moonshot AI (Kimi) or Grok. Separate Chinese lab from xAI.

On Slack specifically:

Viktor is built as a shared AI employee native to the workspace. Anyone can mention him in channels or DMs; he works across 9,800+ tools and posts finished results in the thread. One install serves the whole team, usage-based pricing (free credits then ~$100/mo per workspace).

ChatGPT Dots is primarily a personal agent (ChatGPT Pro/Business, from ~$100/mo). You can reach your own dot in Slack via its handle and carry context across, but by default only the owner directs it—other people’s mentions don’t start work unless you configure that.

Viktor wins for collaborative Slack teams. Dots wins if you already live in the OpenAI stack and want a personal always-on agent that happens to work in Slack too.
